      Biased and selected members.

      Biased and selected members.

      These people have filtered their members and seem to only allow people to be members who are dependent on medications. I had an alternative view and only talked about my experience and put up a link about natural remedies and functional medicine. A day later I discovered I was kicked off. This is not a good forum to be on as they are censoring and sorting their members to get rid of anyone who doesn’t support pharmaceutical use. Obviously there’s more going on behind the scene, money involved or power. A good forum involves people sharing experiences and things that work. There should be no censorship of opinion.

      The best online source of support and advice

      The best online source of support and advice

      HealthUnlocked has been such a help to me over very many years, initially liver related, but now with additional support re kidney issues. I think it has, quite literally saved my life. This is of course due primarily to its contributors, who put themselves out there to support and sometimes offer advice. Users of HealthUnblocked will know what I mean. It is easy to use, always available, and this means that when you need someone to understand, to talk to, there will almost always be a kindly soul to hear you and respond. Long may it continue.
